reauth_confirm.title: Verdi needs a new token
reauth_confirm.description:
Verdi rejected the token, or no token arrived. Usually the Verdi Token Grabber app fixes this on its own:

1. Check that the Verdi Token Grabber app is running.
2. If its log says the login needs interaction, redo the one-time login on a PC with the grabber script.
3. Copy the new verdi_state.json into the app's configuration folder and restart the app.

This prompt closes itself when the next token arrives. Pasting a token below is for testing only.
